text:
jamie: FYI ACME staging private deploy is Wed 10:00am PT. Quick checklist — who owns final egress NAT smoke, airgap image sync, cert/KMS rotation, onprem registry replication, and the post-cutover canary? Need owners assigned by EOD so we can run preflight Tue 2pm PT.
liam: I can own egress NAT smoke test. Will validate NAT connectivity + SNI. Who has a creds jump for the test VM?
sara: I'll take image sync / registry mirroring validation. Need a list of image names + exact digests from infra. ETA ~1h once I have list.
devon: Heads up security wants KMS/HSM key rotation before cutover. That needs a maintenance window and owner. @maria or @ops on rotation?
maria: I can do the cert/KMS rotation. I’ll schedule Tue 2pm preflight slot and run the rotation then. Also want to confirm healthcheck UDP/ICMP exceptions with netops.
liam: For creds: ssh via acme-jump1 to acme-test host. I’ll DM the jump details. Quick curl test we use for egress smoke: ```curl -I https://acme-staging.internal/health -H 'Host: acme.staging' --resolve acme.staging:443:10.0.0.15```
ops-bot: DeployBot: preflight checklist started for thread 4478900000 — results so far: egress: PASS, registry: PENDING, certs: WARN (one cert expires in 6d).
sara: kicking off mirror now. Using sync job with `--verify-digests`. Will post mirror status in ~30–60m.
devon: Note: airgap sync requires signature validation. Make sure sync job uses `--insecure=false` and we have sigs present. Also, HSM rotation may require service restarts — flag that in runbook.
maria: I opened a CR for the firewall rule and rotation window: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234 — please add comments if you need changes.
jamie: Minimal runbook snippet to copy into the CR: ```Steps: 1) run egress curl smoke 2) validate registry digests & image tags 3) rotate certs/KMS keys (coord with ops) 4) run canary traffic against the canary pool 5) monitor token/cost metrics + logs for 30m 6) rollback steps (DNS flip, model fallback)``` Please add any missing critical steps.
liam: Confirmed: I’ll run egress smoke Tue 2:05pm after rotation, and run a small canary load for 10 minutes. Will paste results here.
sara: Mirror completed: all digests verified, tags present. Pushing mirror completion artifacts to the CR. :white_check_mark:
maria: Rotation scheduled and key IDs documented in the CR. Note: KMS rotation will trigger short reloads; coordinated with devon.
devon: Placed a note in the runbook: if HSM restart occurs, run `systemctl restart rwinference-agent` and watch logs `tail -n 200 /var/log/rwinf/*.log`.
jamie: Great. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping me. We'll reconvene tomorrow morning to close owners. Thanks all.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 14:00 PT — preflight window (thread 4478900000).
